title: Login with user name and password
steps: Enter user name and password, press Login
expected: Signed in (HttpOnly session cookie) and taken to Home
actual: 302 -> /; cookie HttpOnly = true, random token = true

title: Login rejected with blank password
steps: Enter user name, leave password blank, press Login
expected: Stay on login page with "Please enter a username and password"

title: Login rejected with wrong password
steps: Enter a valid user name with a wrong password
expected: Not signed in; "Login failed" message; attempt logged

title: Protected page requires sign-in
steps: Open /products without signing in
expected: Redirect (302) to /login

title: Password is masked
steps: Open login page, inspect password field
expected: Characters hidden (input type = password)

title: Home page shows business summary + promo video
steps: Sign in as staff/admin, open Home
expected: 8 items, 3 low, 1 out, 6 invoices, $803.50 total sales; video present

title: Stock list shows all items with key fields
steps: Open Stock
expected: All 8 items listed with SKU, name, price, qty and status badge

title: Search stock
steps: Type "webcam" in search, press Search
expected: Only 1080p HD Webcam CV-10 (LPA-005) shown

title: Add a new stock item (administrator)
steps: Stock > Add item, fill the form, Save
expected: Item saved and its detail page shown

title: Invalid stock item rejected by the server
steps: Submit with no name; then with an existing Stock ID
expected: Not saved (400) with a clear message each time

title: Add form validates before sending (client)
steps: Open Add item, press Save with empty fields
expected: Form not submitted; browser shows "fill out this field"
actual: stayed on form = true; message = "Please fill out this field."

title: Edit a stock item and save
steps: Open item > Edit, change price, Save
expected: New price saved

title: Disable a stock item
steps: Edit item, set status Disabled, Save
expected: Item status is disabled (and it leaves the shop)

title: Stock adjustment - add (staff)
steps: Signed in as staff: item WM-200 > Add stock 5, reason "Restocked", Submit
expected: On hand becomes 12; newest audit entry is this adjustment
actual: on hand 12; newest entry = "Wireless Optical Mouse WM-200 LPA-002 +5 add · 7 → 12 units · Restocke..."

title: Stock can never go negative
steps: Item LPA-008 (on hand 2) > Remove 50
expected: On hand stops at 0 (not -48)

title: Stock reconcile to a counted total
steps: Item LPA-008 > Reconcile to 10
expected: On hand set to exactly 10

title: Delete a stock item (administrator)
steps: Open LPA-009 > Delete > confirm
expected: Item hidden from stock (soft delete, history kept); opening it returns 404

title: Sales & Invoicing lists invoices with total
steps: Open Sales
expected: 6 invoices with Date, Client, Amount; Total $803.50

title: Search invoices (client, date)
steps: Search "DevWorks"; then search "2026-08-01"
expected: DevWorks: 2 invoices, total $220.00; date: 1 invoice (INV-1004)

title: Client records with address; search
steps: Open Clients; search "Northgate"
expected: Address shown; 1 client (CL-004) found

title: Every invoice points to an existing client
steps: Check each invoice clientId against the client list
expected: 0 invoices without a valid client

title: Stock available as JSON (API)
steps: GET /products with Accept: application/json
expected: JSON array of stock items

title: Logout ends the session
steps: Press Logout, then try to open Stock
expected: Sent back to the login page

title: Theme preference is remembered
steps: Settings > choose Dark, then open Home
expected: Home opens in dark theme

title: Mashup pages and About LPA open
steps: Open More > About LPA, Store locator, Pricing
expected: All load (200); About shows LPA mission

title: Home page response time
steps: Request Home 5 times, average the time
expected: Average under 500 ms

title: Audit history records who and when
steps: After UC-12, open Stock > Audit history
expected: Newest entry shows the signed-in user and a time
actual: user shown = true; time shown = true

title: Mobile app opens the LPA interface
steps: Install APK on Pixel 7 emulator, open LPA eComms
expected: Splash screen for ~2 s, then login page inside the app
actual: Static check passed (APK launch activity = SplashActivity; INTERNET permission). On-device run to be recorded.

title: Invoices have line items that add up
steps: For each invoice compare the amount with the sum of its line items
expected: Every invoice has >= 1 item and amount = sum of (qty x price)

title: Pages limited by user group
steps: Open admin pages as staff, staff pages as a customer
data: staff /users; staff /products/new; staff /sales/new; cust /products; cust /sales; cust /clients; cust /api/stock/LPA-001; admin /cart
expected: All refused with 403; staff can still view stock
actual: staff /users 403; staff /products/new 403; staff /sales/new 403; cust /products 403; cust /sales 403; cust /clients 403; cust /api/stock/LPA-001 403; admin /cart 403; staff /products 200

title: Personalised header and menus by user group
steps: Sign in as admin, staff and customer; look at header and menus
expected: Welcome + name + group; customers get Shop/Cart/Orders; Users only for admins
actual: admin welcome = true; staff More has Users = false; customer nav = true; customer welcome = true

title: Customer registration
steps: Login page > Create an account; fill in details; Register; then sign in
expected: Account + client record created; customer can sign in and lands in the shop

title: Registration rejects bad input
steps: Register with a taken user name, short password and mismatched confirmation
expected: Not saved (400) with a message for each problem
actual: 400; taken = true, length = true, match = true

title: Shop lists active items, sortable by price
steps: Shop > sort "Price: low to high"
expected: Only active items (no disabled headset); prices in ascending order
actual: 7 items; headset shown = false; ascending = true (19, 34, 39.5, 69, 89, 149, 429)

title: Cart quantity limited to stock on hand
steps: Add 5 of the dock (4 on hand); add 2; add the out-of-stock monitor
expected: 5 refused; 2 accepted; monitor refused (out of stock)
actual: x5 409 "Only 4 in stock (you already have 0 in your cart)."; x2 200 (cart 2); monitor 409

title: Price shown and confirmed before adding to cart
steps: Shop > Add to cart on the numpad; Cancel; then Add to cart again and confirm
expected: Dialog shows quantity, price and total; Cancel adds nothing; confirm adds it (badge 1)
actual: dialog: "Add to cart?1 × Mechanical Numpad NP-22 at $34.00 each = $34.00 (incl. GST).Add "; after cancel badge 0; after confirm badge 1

title: Cart totals recalculated on the server
steps: Cart: change webcam qty to 3; then set dock qty to 99
expected: Total = 2 x $149 + 3 x $69 = $505.00, GST $45.91; qty 99 refused

title: Checkout needs a payment option
steps: Checkout without choosing a payment option
expected: Order not placed (400): "Choose a payment option"

title: Place an order
steps: Checkout > choose Visa > Place order > confirm
expected: Invoice for CL-006 ($505.00), stock reduced, audit entry "Sold", cart emptied, shown in My orders
actual: 302 -> /orders/INV-1007?placed=1; INV-1007 CL-006 $505.00; dock 4 -> 2; cart empty = true; in My orders = true; audit "Sold - INV-1007"

title: Customers see only their own orders
steps: Open someone else's order as a customer
expected: Not found (404) both times

title: New invoice (administrator)
steps: Sales > Add: search client CL-004, add LPA-002 x2 and LPA-007 x1, Save
data: sent a fake price of $0.01 for LPA-002
expected: Invoice saved with catalogue prices ($39.50 x2 + $34.00 = $113.00); stock reduced
actual: lookups: Northgate High School / Wireless Optical Mouse WM-200; 201 INV-1008 $113.00; mouse 12 -> 10

title: New invoice rejects bad input
steps: Save an invoice for disabled client CL-005 with 500 cables
expected: Refused (400): client disabled; not enough stock
actual: 400; Client CL-005 is disabled. | Only 10 of USB-C to HDMI Cable 2m on hand (asked for 500).

title: Delete an invoice returns its stock
steps: Open INV-1008 > Delete > confirm
expected: Invoice removed (404); 2 mice back in stock

title: Users management (administrator)
steps: Users > Add staff user; sign in; set Inactive; Delete; try to delete own account
expected: Added user can sign in; inactive user cannot; deleted user leaves the list; own account cannot be deleted
actual: add 302; login active -> /; login inactive -> /login?error=2&u=kpatel; listed after delete = false; self-delete -> /users?error=You cannot delete your own account.

title: Passwords are stored as salted hashes
steps: Inspect stored user records
expected: Every password is a scrypt hash with its own salt; no plain text

title: Help guide for each user group
steps: Open More > Help as admin, staff and customer
expected: Help explains each menu; your own group is highlighted

title: Errors do not leak internal details
steps: Send broken JSON to /sales
expected: Plain error (400), no stack trace or file paths

title: Activity log records key events
steps: Read logs/lpa.log after the test run
expected: Failed login, logins, registration, order and invoice events written
actual: failed = true, login = true, register = true, order = true, invoice = true
